test_title: PYST 3: SSC GD Constable 2025 - Reasoning (Held On: 04 Feb, 2025 - Shift 3)
subject: reasoning
question:
Based on the English alphabetical order, three of the following four letter-clusters are alike in a certain way and thus form a group. Which letter-cluster DOES NOT belong to that group?

(**Note:** The odd man out is not based on the number of consonants/vowels or their position in the letter-cluster.)
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/286550159bb1b1af83b0ffca14b226c7cea8abbacc574e15aefc51c80aadcc47.png] 

The pattern followed is,

**Option (1): QZK **

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4338d8dab92939cd133e54def1c8d4b530647ae0206cd99ec9d823d225171247.png] 

Option (2): NYJ

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/742850ff163b93f774f04c33186c3ab37301444b475d4326747703bb8dd8e8cc.png] 

Option (3): CNY 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/a2defca3b0d77e31b22aa25e17d370298664370fcf4ba063da2c84fa81aeffdb.png] 

Option (4): TEP

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f6656dbfd2bb1a1901009bc1ddb673d91ace64f3b163a39a1402a18899a0e3cc.png] 

All follow the same pattern, except ‘QZK’.

Hence, “Option (1)” is the odd one
